# Retained sources

DreamingOfClouds supplies PR3154 and the unchanged TWOSIDE BK/BK7 filter.
Nick Petalas supplies the six retained proof contracts. Original source
paths, exact heads, Git blobs and SHA256 digests are in ../SOURCES.json.
All eight source payloads are retained byte for byte. Their predecessor
notices and E8/P112, joaqcoo, root-simplex and SMALL2/Pencil attribution
remain in the original text. Apache-2.0 applies.

These are conditional mathematical inputs. Replaying this successor
checks caller composition and source binding, not their historical proofs.
